messages:
vendor_ops: Heads up 1: incoming H100 wave AWB `GBR-443-99011` flagged by FRA customs for duplicate invoice check. 36/48 units in hold, estimated 48	60h.
tara_ops: that's our EU reserve topup, right? we just scheduled a canary rollout tomorrow.
kevin_lee: yes, that reserve backs the canary and one short ETA for batch inference in EU-west.
vendor_ops: forwarder proposes two options: 1) pay EUR 2,750 expedite + reissue AWB to divert 12 cleared units to AMS depot now; 2) await customs, estimated 48-60h, no extra freight cost but risk canary delay.
lia_pm: can we do a partial split: divert minimal 12 to AMS to satisfy canary, keep the rest until customs clears?
ams_ops: 12 units staged in AMS would be enough for the canary if QA passes. need pre-registered serials and manifest before arrival.
vendor_ops: we'll provide serial ranges, but customs wants original invoice reconciliation before releasing remaining 36. split requires AWB reissue and EUR 2,750 as mentioned.
finance_team: emergency spend request noted. we can approve up to EUR 3k for freight diversion with post-facto PO amendment and vendor debit note.
kevin_lee: ops ask: what's risk of DOA given vendor's preflight note that 3% had mismatched firmware on last batch?
tara_ops: if we assume 3% of 48 ~ 1-2 units DOA. acceptable risk for canary but we need loaner coverage for quick swap.
vendor_ops: vendor confirms depot-swap loaner window: next-business-48h from AMS receipt; they will pre-print RMA labels and include a photography evidence step at depot.
lia_pm: please request vendor include CSV: serial, model, FW version, manufacture date. also insist on RMA SLA in writing on the debit note.
vendor_ops: doing that. also note: if customs levies administrative penalty we will dispute but that could add 24-48h; forwarder prefers payment to avoid time loss.
shippingbot: Forwarder ETA update queued: holds confirmed. Split request can be actioned once PO amendment received; tentative AMS pickup 08:00 CET tomorrow.
ams_ops: on arrival we will run FW sniff + power smoke test. any unit failing initial smoke -> immediate flagged DOA and vendor to collect under RMA SLA.
finance_team: lia, send PO amendment template. we need final cost line items (diversion fee, insurance delta) and vendor's bank reference for debit note.
lia_pm: prepping PO amendment now. vendor_ops, attach serial CSV and sample RMA label format to this thread so we can approve.
vendor_ops: attached CSV and RMA label sample (will email too). initiating AWB reissue after PO amendment is in.
kevin_lee: decision for the group: proceed with partial split to protect canary. approve diversion spend. execute when PO amendment posted.
tara_ops: agree. schedule AMS staging + QA immediate on handover. track any DOA >2 units as severity.
vendor_ops: acknowledged. will confirm AWB once PO amendment signed. shippingbot will post tracking updates here.
shippingbot: Noted 1: will post AWB reissue and AMS ETA in this thread when active."
